stem:
Meena is doing a shadow activity at home. She holds a cardboard cut-out between a torch and a white wall.
Which change will make the shadow on the wall smaller?

options.text: moving the cardboard cut-out closer to the torch
moving the cardboard cut-out closer to the wall
moving the torch closer to the cardboard cut-out

teacher.key_rationale: Shadow size depends on the relative positions of the source, object, and screen. Moving the cut-out closer to the wall (screen) reduces the spread of the blocked light cone, so the shadow becomes smaller. Options A and C both move the object effectively nearer the source, making the shadow larger; a brighter bulb (D) does not change shadow size.
